answer: A farm running 49 keys therefore pays that exposure on every endorsement it manufactures, which removes the asymmetry that normally makes mass attestation trivial. Because the crystal stake is held until the plume settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the thread audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 42% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer burns proportionally more than endorsing a trivial one. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
